extracted.name: Margaritas on the Rocks
extracted.description: Enjoy a margarita on the rocks made with tequila, triple sec, Grand Marnier, sweet and sour mix, and fresh lime juice for the best summer cocktail.
ingredient_lines: 3 tablespoons kosher salt, or as needed
0.33333334326744 cup brandy-based orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)
instruction_lines: To salt the rims of your glasses: Pour salt onto a small plate, rub the rims of the glasses with lime, and press them into the salt.
Combine sweet and sour mix, tequila, triple sec, and orange liqueur in a blender or pitcher.
Pour into glasses, squeeze a quarter lime into each glass, and serve.
